figure5_hot_digitization.source_location: Figure 5, red filled circles at 1000 K, Pt pressure scale
figure5_hot_digitization.method: Connected components in official source-resolution Figure5 RGB pixels with R>220, G<70, B<70; area 100-500 pixels and y>400. Six red filled-circle Ne markers are separately identifiable; centers are component centroids. Legend, text and calculated curves excluded. Pressure/volume calibrated from printed axes; full centroid precision is retained only for reproducibility, not measurement precision.
figure5_hot_digitization.bound_note: Illustrative combined center/axis coordinate perturbation bound, not experimental uncertainty or a statistical confidence interval. Common offsets are used for extreme sensitivity fits.

finger_1981.identity_verification: Author-institution-hosted publisher scan; title, five authors, journal, year and pages verified visually. Table I Ne columns transcribed and visually checked.
finger_1981.pressure_calibration: Piermarini et al. (1975), DOI 10.1063/1.321957; original reported pressures retained. Fei does not explicitly specify recalibration of this Finger subset.

coexistence_observation.note: Table I; excluded from PV fitting because no volume is printed. Narrative/abstract instead says 47.4 +/- 0.5 kbar. Both reports retained without resolving discrepancy.

finger_1981.parameter_provenance: Fei adopts V0, theta0 and gamma0 from Finger Table II. Finger V0=13.394 cm3/mol is a low-temperature adopted value; theta0=75.1 K is from Fugate & Swenson (1973). Finger gamma1=2.05 is the coefficient of gamma=1/2+gamma1*(V/V0), not the Fei gamma(V0). Fei nevertheless prints gamma0=2.05; it is preserved as Fei's choice.
finger_1981.copyright_note: Source rights remain with the source holder; any Peritheos CC0 contribution covers transcription, conversion and metadata only.

retrieval_checks.pmc_html: Fetched complete article (165629 bytes); no supplemental-data links or new Ne numerical table present.
retrieval_checks.doi_dataset_search: DOI searches with Zenodo/figshare filters and supplementary-data terms found no original Ne or paired Pt/Au dataset. This is a scoped unsuccessful search, not proof none exists.
retrieval_checks.paired_calibrant_volumes: Not recovered for new Fei Ne observations; Pt and Au model inversions would be synthetic estimates, not measured paired inputs.
retrieval_checks.dewaele_2008: DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.77.094106, pp.094106-2,-5,-9. Replots six Fei hot observations and discusses reference-state reinterpretation in note29, but does not tabulate those Fei observations or paired calibrant volumes. Its Table I contains separate new Dewaele measurements.
